title: Guess the Cuisine
notes: Cuisine photos are stored in the repository as locally optimized WebP files so gameplay does not fetch each photo from Wikimedia Commons.
Each image retains sourcePage, sourceUrl, cachedSourceUrl, creator, and license metadata. If sourceUrl changes, the cache refreshes that local WebP.
Photo rendering in the published GitHub Pages site must still be checked before questions are marked approved.

questions.explanation: Sushi is built around vinegared rice, often paired with seafood, vegetables or egg.
Tacos are typically made with a tortilla folded or wrapped around a filling.
Neapolitan pizza is associated with Naples and is known for its soft centre and raised rim.
Biryani is a South Asian rice dish layered or cooked with spices and often vegetables, meat or seafood.
Pho is a Vietnamese noodle soup, commonly served with broth, rice noodles, herbs and meat or other toppings.
Paella is a Spanish rice dish traditionally cooked in a wide, shallow pan and associated with Valencia.
A croissant is a buttery, flaky pastry made by layering dough and butter.
Pad Thai is a Thai stir-fried rice-noodle dish commonly made with tamarind, egg, bean sprouts and peanuts.
A samosa is a savoury pastry often filled with spiced potatoes and peas, though fillings vary by region.
Peruvian ceviche is traditionally made with raw fish marinated in citrus and seasoned with chilli and salt.

questions.explanation: Dosa is a South Indian crepe-like dish made from a fermented batter, commonly based on rice and lentils.
Falafel consists of seasoned ground chickpeas or fava beans, shaped into balls or patties and fried.
Hummus is a dip made mainly from chickpeas blended with tahini, lemon and other seasonings.
Chinese dumplings are parcels of dough filled with ingredients such as meat, seafood or vegetables, prepared in several ways.
Moussaka is a layered dish especially associated with Greek cuisine, commonly made with eggplant and a savoury filling.
Goulash is a Hungarian dish traditionally prepared as a seasoned soup or stew, often with paprika.
Jerk is a Jamaican cooking style known for a spicy marinade or seasoning that commonly includes allspice and Scotch bonnet pepper.
Pierogi are filled dumplings associated with Central and Eastern European cuisines, especially Poland.
Bibimbap is a Korean rice dish served with a range of toppings, often including vegetables, gochujang and egg or meat.

questions.explanation: Ramen is a Japanese noodle soup usually served in broth with toppings such as sliced meat, egg, vegetables or seaweed.

questions.explanation: Okonomiyaki is a Japanese savoury pancake made with a flour-based batter and ingredients such as cabbage, often finished with sauces and toppings.

questions.explanation: Shakshuka features eggs cooked in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce and is popular across parts of North Africa and the Middle East.
Empanadas are filled pastries baked or fried in many Latin American and Iberian food traditions, with fillings that vary by region.
A Moroccan tagine is a slow-cooked stew named after the distinctive earthenware cooking vessel traditionally used to prepare it.
Injera is a spongy, fermented flatbread that serves as a staple in Ethiopian cuisine and is often used to scoop up stews.
Bibingka is a Filipino rice cake traditionally baked in a lined pan and especially associated with the Christmas season.
Taita fit-fit is a traditional Eritrean dish made with pieces of flatbread mixed with spiced butter and seasonings.

questions.explanation: Poutine is a Canadian dish, especially associated with Quebec, made with fries, cheese curds and hot gravy.
Baklava is a layered pastry made with thin filo dough, chopped nuts and syrup or honey, popular across parts of the Middle East and Mediterranean.
Japanese curry rice pairs a thick, mildly spiced curry sauce—often with vegetables and meat—with steamed rice.
Onigiri are Japanese rice balls, often shaped by hand or in moulds and commonly wrapped in nori, with savoury fillings.

questions.explanation: Butter chicken is an Indian curry featuring chicken in a creamy tomato-based sauce seasoned with spices.

Borscht is a soup associated especially with Ukraine and other Eastern European cuisines, often recognized by its beetroot-red colour.
Bánh mì is a Vietnamese sandwich typically served in a crisp baguette with savoury fillings, pickled vegetables, herbs and condiments.
Koshari is an Egyptian street-food dish combining rice, lentils and pasta, commonly topped with fried onions and tomato sauce.
Udon are thick Japanese wheat noodles, often served in a hot broth with toppings such as scallions, tofu or tempura.
